claim_text: Sara Beck asked whether there was CIA involvement among the anti-government protesters (reported contemporaneously as: 'I heard about CIA involvement among these anarchists?').
discovery_sources: ICE 2023-03-02 contemporaneous report; The Seventh Eye 2023-03-07 report with screenshot and stronger paraphrase; later reporting on separate alleged Mossad-protest advocacy claim
resolution_notes: Targeted recheck did not justify an adverse verdict. The closest contemporaneous transcription is interrogative rather than a clean categorical assertion; The Seventh Eye paraphrases the exchange more strongly as the CIA operating/standing behind the protests. Exact original Channel 14 video remains unavailable, and later US-intelligence reporting concerned a different alleged Mossad role, not direct evidence resolving Beck's CIA wording. Preserve as Unresolved rather than infer False/Unsupported from absence of evidence.
media_status: Exact broadcast screenshot is preserved by The Seventh Eye; original Channel 14 clip/direct asset remains unavailable after targeted recovery attempts.
